name: ajitta-socratic
description: One plugin holding the two portable Socratic skills from portable-skills/: a questioning-led brainstorm and Plato's elenchus. The SuperClaude framework itself is installed with the superclaude CLI, not from this marketplace.

plugins.name: socratic
plugins.description: Two Socratic skills. socratic-brainstorm tests an idea one question at a time, then your own options plus up to three labeled ones, convergence by criteria, and an honest verdict with a short brief. socratic-elenchus runs Plato's what-is-X dialogue: premises you agree to, a contradiction built from them, and your revised definitions. Usually ends in aporia. No advice.
